description.en: Equipment checklist use, ESU setup, fasting compliance, antibiotic-prophylaxis judgement, and team-briefing before commencing POEM.

criteria.en: Requires prompting to execute; recognises the need for poem preprocedure preparation but cannot yet perform reliably.
Performs poem preprocedure preparation independently to source-defined standards.
Teaches poem preprocedure preparation to trainees; handles atypical/complex cases.

provenance.reason: Atomic-skill decomposition of the source-canonical ESGE POEM 2025 Part II recommendations into trainee-assessable units. The POEM curriculum enumerates recommendations and the PPAT scores procedures; this competency frame is Evideris's design for portfolio-level tracking.
